title: The Mystery of the Magical Music Box
synopsis: Starting where Episode 13 ended, Pico waves goodbye ('Good luck with the music box!') and the friends jump into the Rainbow Heart's image. They drop into the courtyard of an enchanted castle on a floating island: beautiful towers, giant golden instruments and floating notes, but strangely silent. Bobo's claps make no sound and his 'Hello-o!' gets no echo, Kiko plays an invisible piano, Draco's dragon music magic produces one tiny squeak, and Bobo's rumbling tummy is the loudest sound in the castle ('Even my stomach makes more music than this castle!'). Off-key singing behind the silent fountain turns out to be Melody, a tiny pastel-pink musical fox and guardian of the Magical Music Box, whose melody is lost. Her proud demo cracks so badly that the stone singing-bird statue looks confused and Bobo covers his ears ('Was that a song or a sleepy dinosaur?' 'It was supposed to be a beautiful melody!'). At the golden Music Door, five symbols glow in a pattern; Melody's tail sends glowing notes, Kiko secretly taps a silly tune and the door blows a raspberry, Draco honks like a goose, Bobo dances to the wrong beat ('my feet definitely do!'), and together they follow the glow and the door opens. In the Hall of Instruments, Kiko sets everything off at once, 'Maestro Draco' conducts chaos and gets tooted in the face, and Bobo backs into the giant banana drum: BOOM ('the world's biggest banana drum!'). Three notes are missing from the music box: Lumi solves the bell stairs, Kiko bounces off the drum to catch a floating note, and Draco melts a frozen bell with a tiny, careful flame ('I knew my musical talent would help!' 'You were making sounds like a broken trumpet!'). Melody fears she'll ruin the last note, Lumi encourages her, and she sings it beautifully: the music box plays, the castle fills with colour, the fountains flow, everyone dances, Draco spins into a pile of cushions, and Bobo finds a tiny golden banana music box with a dancing banana inside.
ending: The restored music box projects a floating flower garden above a lake. 'Another magical mystery! Let's discover where that garden leads!' Next: The Secret of the Floating Flower Garden.
newCharacters: Melody, a tiny pastel-pink musical fox and guardian of the Magical Music Box: big violet eyes with star sparkles, large ears with lavender tips, a fluffy tail with a soft rainbow gradient and white tip that sends glowing notes, a golden music-note mark on the forehead, a little golden bell collar and tiny glowing stars around her paws; friendly, playful and musical, hears melodies others can't, sometimes sings wildly off-key and gets embarrassed (blushes, ears droop); learned to believe in her own voice (Melody in src/ep14/props.tsx, voice af_aoede pitched 1.3; her singing is her own voice re-pitched by scripts/sing_kit.py)
